headline: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug discovery company spun out of Google DeepMind, is in early talks to raise money at a valuation of at least $40 billion.
score_reason: Pool score 7 kept: the headline matches the article (early talks), so it is not overstated; the valuation is from people familiar, noted in the summary.
importance_line: It shows investors paying heavily for AI-led drug discovery, but the talks are early, the valuation comes from people familiar with the effort, and few AI drug developers have yet reached clinical trials.
summary: Bloomberg reports, citing people familiar with the effort, that London-based Isomorphic Labs is in early talks to raise new funds at a valuation of at least $40 billion, possibly as high as $50 billion. The financing has not closed and details could change; the talks come five months after a $2.1 billion Series B round, and Isomorphic has partnerships with Eli Lilly and Novartis.
notes: Bloomberg blocked here (403). Facts read in the Bloomberg text as carried by Yahoo Finance UK, with Bloomberg credit. Link is the Bloomberg link from the chunk. Isomorphic did not respond to comment (per Bloomberg).
